name: How can I tell if the black spots are mold or just dirt?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if the black spots are mold or just dirt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Distinguishing between mold and dirt on a ceiling can be challenging. Mold often appears fuzzy, slimy, or powdery, and may spread in irregular patterns. It can also have a musty or earthy odor. Dirt, conversely, usually appears as dust or grime and does not typically grow or have an associated smell. If you are unsure, gently dab a small area with a cotton swab dipped in bleach. If the spot lightens or disappears, it is likely mold. However, for large or persistent areas, professional assessment is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold is often fuzzy, slimy, or powdery with a musty smell, spreading in irregular patterns. Dirt is typically just dust. A bleach test can help identify mold, but professional assessment is best for significant issues.
